m: Soak the noodles in hot (not boiling) water for 15 minutes until bendy but still firm. Drain.
Sauce: fish sauce, brown sugar, tomato sauce, the juice of half the limes and 1 tbsp water per serve. Stir until the sugar dissolves.
Slice the chicken thin and stir-fry in a very hot wok until cooked. Push to one side.
Add the garlic, then crack in the eggs and scramble them into the chicken.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss constantly for 2 to 3 minutes until the sauce is absorbed. Cook in two batches if your wok is small.
Toss through the bean sprouts and spring onion. Serve with crushed peanuts, chilli flakes and lime wedges.
l: Reheat with a splash of water so the noodles loosen up. Fresh lime over the top brings it back.
g: Naturally gluten free with rice noodles. Check the fish sauce and tomato sauce labels.
